A '''system bombard''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] commanded by a [[systems admiral]]. It was comprised of three [[bombard squadron]]s, and a [[light squadron]], for a total average of one hundred [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. As their name suggests, the formation is tasked with carrying out planetary bombardment missions.
